//: Configuration B: the reference executor against the other back ends. Both sides name the same
install -- this is not a comparison of two builds but of two schedulers of one build -- and
each side names the pass list it runs the program with. A block's own terminal scheduling
pass is replaced by that list, so a case that pins `std::jit` is compared with `std::nvm`
std::jit                     the same VM with the code generator (a build without one runs
`std::fvm` and says so on stderr; the warning is a fact about
the build and appears on both sides equally)
std::cxx::inline, std::fvm   a pipeline in front of the back end, as test/vars.toml writes it
The graph reading is not part of this configuration: both sides share the front end, so the
graph they produce is the same graph by construction. The output and time readings are.
label: step0-b-nvm-vs-fvm
